Name: Hardware
Description: Issues related to computers, laptops, monitors, keyboards, mice, and other physical equipment.

Name: Software
Description: Issues related to software applications, operating systems, and installed programs.

Name: Network
Description: Issues related to network connectivity, Wi-Fi, LAN, VPN, and Internet access.

Name: Account
Description: Issues related to user accounts, login problems, passwords, and account permissions.

Name: Printer
Description: Issues related to printers, scanners, printing errors, and print configuration.

Name: Email
Description: Issues related to email accounts, sending or receiving emails, and email configuration.

Name: Security
Description: Issues related to security incidents, suspicious activity, malware, and access control.

Name: Server
Description: Issues related to servers, shared folders, system services, and server availability.

Name: Mobile Device
Description: Issues related to smartphones, tablets, mobile applications, and device configuration.

Name: Other
Description: IT issues that do not belong to any of the available categories.
